title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length
description: Given a lowercase string `s` and an integer `k`, return the maximum number of vowel letters (`'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, `'u'`) contained in any contiguous substring of `s` of length `k`.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Maintain a fixed-size sliding window of length k.
When advancing by one character, add 1 if the incoming character is a vowel and subtract 1 if the outgoing character at i - k is a vowel.

examples.explanation: The substring "iii" of length 3 contains 3 vowels.
Any length-2 substring of "aeiou" contains 2 vowels.
The substring "lee" (or "eet") of length 3 contains 2 vowels.
